attempts.summary: Brought node1's unconfigured lan-b-facing NIC (vtnet2) into service as a new OPNsense zone (opt1/"LANB", 10.60.60.1/24) with a firewall pass rule, giving node3 direct reachability to node1 and, via OPNsense's automatic outbound NAT plus a host route on node3, routed reachability to node2 on lan-a (10.100.25.11) through node1. Verified with TTL decrement and pf state-table evidence. All three nodes were then individually restarted via native reboot mechanisms; boot identity changes were confirmed and full connectivity/config were verified to persist after each restart.
